properties.name: hormuz_core
properties.description: Core Strait of Hormuz corridor: Gulf-side approach (Bandar Abbas / Qeshm latitude), the narrowest section near 56.5E, and the Gulf of Oman approach toward Musandam. Polygon is a hand-drawn corridor in EPSG:4326 (WGS84 lon/lat), clockwise, closed.
properties.notes: Includes some land (Iran, Qeshm, Musandam, UAE coast). Land is inside the AOI area denominator; SAR footprint intersection is computed on the full polygon. Replace this geometry if a water-only AOI is preferred.
